translations.web: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
translations.bsb: And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”
translations.kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
translations.asv: And when they were filled, he saith unto his disciples, Gather up the broken pieces which remain over, that nothing be lost.
